_comment: CLEAN pre-refit feature baseline for the genius scorer (score_v2). REPLACES feature_baseline.json for refit-judging purposes. That artefact (round 39) was frozen over 2026-07-15..2026-08-08, a window that straddles the 'Gatwick' exemplar-pool contamination which began 2026-07-26 and ended when round 32's dedup shipped at 2026-08-07T16:10:55Z. 12.6% of its fires are contaminant, and contaminant fires differ on ALL FOUR deployed features, so any refit judged against it would inherit round 32's cleanup as fake credit. The R39 file is deliberately KEPT, not overwritten, so the correction stays auditable. Fitted data -- do not regenerate after a refit.

supersedes.why_retired: window straddles the Gatwick contamination (2026-07-26 -> 2026-08-07T16:10:55Z). Its F4 daily mean of 0.02717 is the average of 11 clean days at 0.00484 and 13 contaminated days at 0.04740 and describes neither regime. See observation_reports/r48.md and r49.md.

primary_window.verification: OBSERVED: 0 contaminant fires on all 11 days (exact zero, not merely low); contaminant is also 0 on every day from 2026-06-25 back through 2026-07-13. maxDF* over crystallized beliefs reads 10-20% across the window against a backtest median of 12% and threshold 25% -- no breach. Largest near-duplicate first-sentence cluster is 411 fires (11.1%), and it is 100% hot_branch='quiescent', i.e. the DESIGNED raw-dump path at generator.py:800, not a story attractor. The largest non-structural cluster is 52 fires (1.4%), against two clusters of 701 and 697 (21.1% combined) in the contaminated window.

secondary_window_post_r32._comment: The other clean window: current regime, but only 3 days. Recorded so a future round can choose which regime to judge against rather than having to re-derive it.

primary_window_excluding_quiescent._comment: Same primary window with hot_branch='quiescent' dropped. That path is a bare feed payload by design (every 5th fire) and is 19.6% of the window; it has F5=0.0 by construction and inflates F1. Provided so a refit can choose whether to model it.

F2_FIXED_REF_reference_set._comment: R39's artefact recorded an F2_FIXED_REF value but not WHICH thoughts formed the frozen reference, so round 47 could not reproduce it (got ~0.934 against a recorded 0.99965). That gap is closed here: the reference set is stored by id and hashed. To reproduce, load these 50 fountain_events rows in ts ASC order and pass their `thought` values as `prior_thoughts` to feat_anti_template().
F2_FIXED_REF_reference_set.definition: the 50 fires immediately PRECEDING the primary window start, ts ASC
F2_FIXED_REF_reference_set.sha256_method: sha256 of the 50 thought strings joined by '\n\x00\n', utf-8

F3_t6_promotion: not measured -- deployed weight is exactly 0.0, contributes nothing
source: fountain_events; features recomputed with score_v2.py as deployed
caveats: PRE-MODE-LOGGING. The `mode` column was only written from 2026-08-03 (commit 9c26ccd); wide modes themselves have run since 2026-06-22 (bf0d5bd). Every fire in the primary window has mode=NULL, meaning 'not recorded', NOT 'no mode'. Per-mode baselines are therefore unavailable in the primary window; use the secondary post-R32 window for anything per-mode.

PRE-R28 and PRE-R29. The primary window predates the scorer weight change ab1b8a6 (2026-07-27) and the crystallization-ceiling change 7c04a56 (2026-08-03). It is clean of contamination but it is four changes back from the current regime.

The register-exclusion list used by maxDF* (register_exclusion.json, fitted 2026-06-20..2026-08-04) itself spans the contamination, violating its own header rule ('refit ONLY on a corpus with no active convergence in it'). Three contaminant tokens -- changes, shifts, systems -- sit in its 40 terms. It was NOT refit here: the clean window holds only 284 crystallized beliefs against the 1101 R31 used, and a 40-term refit on that sample misclassifies register vocabulary ('news') as an attractor and produces a spurious 34% breach. Refitting it needs its own round and a bigger clean corpus.
Composition was checked and is comparable across windows: quiescent share 19.6% (primary) vs 19.9% (post-R32) vs 19.7% (R39's), so F5's branch mix is not a confound between them.
